query.description: Device의 Chain 전체 삭제 (하위 Chain 테이블은 FK CASCADE)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id

query.description: Device의 Chain 목록 + 저장 상태 / Member 수 / 편집 수
query.commandtext: SELECT C.CHAIN_SEQ, C.CHAIN_CODE, V.CHAIN_NAME, V.COLOR_ARGB, V.APPLY_LAYER_RULES, TO_CHAR(V.CELL_SIZE, 'TM9', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=''.,''') AS CELL_SIZE, NVL(V.VERSION_STATUS, 'DRAFT') AS VERSION_STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER M WHERE M.FACTORY = C.FACTORY AND M.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND M.CHAIN_SEQ = C.CHAIN_SEQ AND M.VERSION_NO = 1) AS MEMBER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_EDIT E WHERE E.FACTORY = C.FACTORY AND E.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND E.CHAIN_SEQ = C.CHAIN_SEQ AND E.VERSION_NO = 1) AS EDIT_COUNT, NVL(C.UPDATE_USER, C.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, TO_CHAR(NVL(C.UPDATE_TIME, C.CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN C LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V ON V.FACTORY = C.FACTORY AND V.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND V.CHAIN_SEQ = C.CHAIN_SEQ AND V.VERSION_NO = 1 WHERE C.FACTORY = :factory AND C.DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY LENGTH(C.CHAIN_CODE), C.CHAIN_CODE
SELECT CHAIN_SEQ, CHAIN_CODE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq

query.description: Chain 1건 (Chain Code, 신규 Code 중복 확인)
query.commandtext: SELECT CHAIN_SEQ, CHAIN_CODE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_CODE = :chain_code
INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, CHAIN_CODE, CHAIN_STATUS, CREATE_USER) VALUES (:factory, :device_id, :chain_seq, :chain_code, 'ACTIVE', :create_user)

query.description: Chain 수정 사용자 / 일시 갱신 (다시 저장)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_CHAIN SET UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq

query.description: Chain 1개 실제 삭제 (하위 VER / MEMBER / LAYER / RULE / EDIT는 FK CASCADE)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq

query.description: Map 복사: Chain 마스터 1개를 새 Chain 번호로 (Code 그대로)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, CHAIN_CODE, CHAIN_STATUS, CREATE_USER) SELECT FACTORY, :target_device_id, :new_chain_seq, CHAIN_CODE, CHAIN_STATUS, :create_user FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :source_device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :source_chain_seq

query.description: Chain 번호 여러 개 한 번에 채번 (시퀀스 CHAIN_SEQ, 행마다 새 번호)
query.commandtext: SELECT CHAIN_SEQ.NEXTVAL AS CHAIN_SEQ FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= :seq_count

query.description: Device 의 Chain 번호 / Code / 이름 / 색 / 저장 상태 (포함 도형 수 계산 없음 - Chain 이 많을 때 목록용)
query.commandtext: SELECT C.CHAIN_SEQ, C.CHAIN_CODE, V.CHAIN_NAME, V.COLOR_ARGB, NVL(V.VERSION_STATUS, 'DRAFT') AS VERSION_STATUS, TO_CHAR(NVL(C.UPDATE_TIME, C.CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN C LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V ON V.FACTORY = C.FACTORY AND V.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND V.CHAIN_SEQ = C.CHAIN_SEQ AND V.VERSION_NO = 1 WHERE C.FACTORY = :factory AND C.DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY C.CHAIN_CODE
